Good to know

Do I need any experience?

None at all. Every trip starts with half an hour on the sand learning the strokes.

What if the weather turns?

We move the trip or refund it in full. The sea decides, not the calendar.

What should I bring?

Warm layers, a hat and shoes that can get wet. We bring everything else.
